visualReview.notes: Inspected11 current portable views,including the retained1024×640 summary. Original medium-fi geometry retains nine mapped plans. The notched hall carries two adjoining curved roof volumes and a red timber door/screen facade. Small pavilion bays are open around a central screen. The tower has two stacked grey roofs,green ridges and a red gourd-like finial. Side ranges retain their spacing. Corrected roof-ring folding/pale gaps,closed raised eave edges and shortened ridge caps to meet their roof tops. Fine dougong,roof-end sculpture,floral painting,inscriptions,temporary braces,fences,trees and furnished interiors are omitted.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected11 current shared-material/geographic-flat views and the placement overlay. Six existing256² graphs serve seven merged roles: brick,lime plaster,raw limestone,plain wood,ceramic tile,glazed tile and local opaque glazing. Blue-green beams and red timber use shared wood with linear vertex tints. Meter-scaled UVs,zero embedded images,no unique facade atlas. Each graph is read once;eviction disposes geometry and restores host ground. Nine nearby mapped host buildings remain separate,including the north annex and east apartment. Flat placement verifies pose/replacement behavior;exact courtyard grade remains approximate.

fidelityReview.notes: Individual Niujie Mosque compound: the mapped notched prayer hall and auxiliary ranges, small square pavilion, stacked Chinese tower, grey upturned tile roofs with green glazed accents, red timber screens/doors and blue-green beam accents. Paired side ranges and two narrow connecting paths retain the mapped spacing. Fine dougong, roof-end sculpture, floral painting, inscriptions, planting, temporary supports and furnished interiors are omitted. Functional labels and unpictured roof forms remain explicit estimates. No retained height/width/length facts or current building height tags are available. All vertical dimensions are picture-guided estimates: hall walls6.6 m and roof about10.7 m, stacked tower about13.5 m, small pavilion5.8 m and auxiliary ranges6–7 m. No independent survey or engineering precision is claimed. This declared Chinese-style compound is guided by two inspected2006/2008 pictures and current ordinary PMTiles/DEM. The pictures establish the tiered roof and red/blue-green timber vocabulary;they do not prove the current complete roof plan. Functional assignments,membership,entry facing,roof forms,bay counts,all heights and two connecting paths remain estimates.
